scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: One input, two lanes
scenes.caption: In the Decision Lab, Aditi gives both methods the same fictional card batch and the same required result. Vihaan states a counted operation before starting. Fair comparison needs matching inputs, outputs and counting rules.
scenes.speech: In the Decision Lab, Aditi gives both methods the same fictional card batch and the same required result. Vihaan states a counted operation before starting. Fair comparison needs matching inputs, outputs and counting rules.
scenes.dialogue: Define the unit of work first.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Count inspections
scenes.caption: Method A inspects each card once. Method B inspects every ordered pair, including pairs of a card with itself. Neither exits early in this supplied model. The counters record inspections only, leaving setup, loop control and elapsed time outside this particular measurement.
scenes.speech: Method A inspects each card once. Method B inspects every ordered pair, including pairs of a card with itself. Neither exits early in this supplied model. The counters record inspections only, leaving setup, loop control and elapsed time outside this particular measurement.
scenes.dialogue: Do not count an unrequested operation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Double the input
scenes.caption: They double the batch while leaving both algorithms unchanged. Aditi keeps the operation definition fixed. The new counts follow from the rules, not from how quickly the animation seems to move.
scenes.speech: They double the batch while leaving both algorithms unchanged. Aditi keeps the operation definition fixed. The new counts follow from the rules, not from how quickly the animation seems to move.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Predict before measuring
scenes.caption: Vihaan suggests that both totals must merely double because both received twice as many cards. Decide using the explicit inspection formulas. Their prediction includes counts and the assumptions supporting those formulas.
scenes.speech: Vihaan suggests that both totals must merely double because both received twice as many cards. Decide using the explicit inspection formulas. Their prediction includes counts and the assumptions supporting those formulas.
scenes.dialogue: A pair count depends on both positions.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Plot exact scale points
scenes.caption: Their scale display uses a few discrete batch sizes and the exact counts from each rule. The pair lane grows faster in this operation measure. That finding does not automatically establish memory use or actual elapsed time on every device.
scenes.speech: Their scale display uses a few discrete batch sizes and the exact counts from each rule. The pair lane grows faster in this operation measure. That finding does not automatically establish memory use or actual elapsed time on every device.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A qualified decision
scenes.caption: Aditi selects a method under a stated inspection budget only after checking that its promised result applies. They retain formulas, input sizes and limits with the decision. A single timed demonstration can describe that run, but cannot prove a universal speed advantage.
